_readme: Entries for tools/check-exports.mjs. Each value MUST start with a category tag before the colon: 'false-positive' (something does use it and the parser cannot see that) or 'dead' (nothing uses it and it should be deleted). A 'dead' entry is a promise to delete, not a licence to keep. The gate prints the per-category counts on every run, and it fails on a stale entry, so this file cannot rot silently.
src/js/habits.js::renderHabits: false-positive: loaded by name from the sidebar in shell.js — import('./habits.js').then(m => m.renderHabits()), which the parser reports as a dynamic site
src/js/countdown.js::renderCountdowns: false-positive: same sidebar pattern in shell.js — import('./countdown.js').then(m => m.renderCountdowns())
src/js/noise.js::openNoiseHarbor: false-positive: dynamic load from the Today card and the drawer — import('../noise.js').then(m => m.openNoiseHarbor())
src/js/tasks.js::sortKey: false-positive: the only other mention in the tree is an unrelated local function of the same name in tools/build-sw.mjs
